questions.question: The underlined word "its" in paragraph 1 refers to ...............
The underlined word "vastness" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ...............
According to paragraph 2, which of the following shows the correct chronological order of events?
choices: The sailing of three ships under Magellan's command before Balboa's death
The Mariana Islands taking their current name before Magellan's death
Magellan reaching the Mariana Islands after Balboa's death
Balboa's birth after the Ladrones islands taking their name

questions.question: All of the following words are mentioned in the passage EXCEPT ...............
According to the passage, which of the following statements is true?
choices: Pacific Islanders employed their knowledge of oceanography to export food to South America.
On his way to the Mariana Islands, Magellan sailed past three islets, which had no native residents.
Voyagers from the Indonesian islands never set foot into the central Pacific before the 16th century.
Balboa and Magellan named the Pacific Ocean and the Ladrones islands respectively.
